upstreamCapabilities.description: OpenAI frontier reasoning model with SOTA capabilities across computer use, coding, cybersecurity, and science. Context window 1.05M tokens, max output 128K tokens. Knowledge cutoff Apr 30, 2026.

OpenAI image generation and editing model supporting text-to-image, image-to-image edits and variations via OpenAI-compatible /v1/images endpoints. Dated snapshot variants (e.g. gpt-image-2-2026-04-21) share the same pattern. Litellm lists per-pixel pricing of $5e-6 input / $1e-5 output.

OpenAI GPT Image 2.5 family base alias; the API exposes two concrete variants (Flare as the fast default, Sunburst as the precision tier), both supporting text-to-image, image editing and variations via OpenAI-compatible /v1/images endpoints. Token rates match GPT Image 2: text input $5.00/M (cached $1.25/M), image input $8.00/M (cached $2.00/M), image output $30.00/M.

OpenAI fast, high-quality everyday image generation and editing model (small GPT Image 2.5 variant optimized for speed, ~50% lower latency than GPT Image 2 with comparable image quality). Supports low/medium/high/xhigh/max/auto quality settings via OpenAI-compatible /v1/images endpoints. Dated snapshot gpt-image-2.5-flare-2026-09-08 shares the same pattern. Token rates match GPT Image 2: text input $5.00/M (cached $1.25/M), image input $8.00/M (cached $2.00/M), image output $30.00/M.

OpenAI flagship-precision image generation and editing model (base GPT Image 2.5 variant optimized for quality, higher image fidelity than GPT Image 2 with longer generation times). Supports low/medium/high/xhigh/max/auto quality settings via OpenAI-compatible /v1/images endpoints. Dated snapshot gpt-image-2.5-sunburst-2026-09-08 shares the same pattern. Token rates match GPT Image 2: text input $5.00/M (cached $1.25/M), image input $8.00/M (cached $2.00/M), image output $30.00/M.
Z.AI flagship coding model with 1M-context Coding Plan support and low/high/max thinking intensity. The [1m] suffix is the official long-context alias.

GLM-5 series' first native multimodal model (320B total / 18B active, hybrid linear+sparse attention) with stronger-than-GLM-5.2 intelligence at flash-tier cost. Accepts image/video/file input and supports function calling, streaming tool calls and structured output; thinking is always on (cannot be disabled) with low/high/max effort levels. BigModel publishes no pay-as-you-go token pricing (GLM Coding Plan bills via credit quotas); token pricing here follows the concordant LiteLLM databricks/friendliai mirrors ($0.15/$0.50/cache $0.03), with OpenRouter's z-ai/glm-5.3-flash pass-through even lower ($0.075/$0.25). The [1m] suffix selects the full 1M-context alias.
Zhipu flagship coding model with dynamic thinking, configurable reasoning effort, and streaming tool-call arguments on the OpenAI Chat API.
Zhipu GLM-5.2 served by AtomGit with the standard 200K-token context window. Capabilities mirror the GLM-5.2 family; AtomGit does not publish unified token pricing.

Zhipu agent-focused text model (ClawBench enhanced) optimized for tool calling, instruction following and long-chain execution; text-only input. Token pricing from LiteLLM novita/openrouter mirrors of zai-org.
Zhipu GLM-5 family fallback. Pricing comes from LiteLLM zai/glm-5.
Lightweight multimodal agent model for text chat, image understanding, tool calling, and streaming responses.
LongCat API model available through OpenAI-compatible and Anthropic-compatible endpoints. Pricing uses the published limited-time discounted API pay-as-you-go rates.
StepFun flagship multimodal reasoning model with native image/video input, tool calling, and three reasoning-effort levels.
Qwen flagship multimodal reasoning model. The deprecated qwen3.8-max-preview ID is automatically routed to qwen3.8-max by Model Studio.
Qwen3.7 Max text model. The model detail page states this release is functionally equivalent to snapshot qwen3.7-max-2026-05-20.

Qwen3.7 Plus multimodal model. The model detail page states this release is functionally equivalent to snapshot qwen3.7-plus-2026-05-26. Pricing is tiered by input length; top-level prices mirror the <=256K tier for compatibility.

Smallest model in DeepSeek's new architecture family with native multimodal visual understanding. deepseek-flash is the current API alias. Supports thinking (default) and non-thinking modes. Off-peak (base) prices listed; peak hours (Beijing Mon-Fri 09:00-12:00 & 14:00-18:00) double all prices.

Retired on 2026-09-10; requests are served by DeepSeek V4.1 Flash and billed at the new Flash price. Supports thinking and non-thinking modes. deepseek-chat is a deprecated compatibility alias for the non-thinking mode. Off-peak (base) prices listed; peak hours (Beijing 09:00-12:00 & 14:00-18:00) double all prices.

Retired on 2026-09-10; requests are served by DeepSeek V4.1 Flash (native multimodal) and billed at the new Flash price. Images are converted into tokens by dimensions and billed as input tokens. No FIM support. Off-peak (base) prices listed; peak hours (Beijing 09:00-12:00 & 14:00-18:00) double all prices.

Supports thinking and non-thinking modes. deepseek-reasoner is a deprecated compatibility alias for the thinking mode. From 2026-09-14 12:00 Beijing time, requests to deepseek-v4-pro are routed to V4.1 Flash and billed at the V4.1 Flash price until the future V4.1 Pro release. Off-peak (base) prices listed; peak hours (Beijing 09:00-12:00 & 14:00-18:00) double all prices.
Kimi K3 (1M context window; Moderato plan limited to 256K). Moonshot Kimi Code flagship coding model.
Kimi K3 (1M context window). Moonshot Kimi Code flagship coding model with extended context.
Kimi K3 (256K context window). Moonshot Kimi Code flagship coding model, half-price 256K variant.

upstreamCapabilities.displayName: Kimi K2.8 Preview (Kimi Code 会员)
upstreamCapabilities.description: Kimi Code standard coding model, upgraded to K2.8 Preview (2026-09) under the same model ID. Overall performance close to K3 with more efficient thinking; 1M context for all membership tiers; reasoning effort low/high/max (default max); requests with thinking disabled are served by the non-thinking K2.8 Preview path.
Kimi Code high-speed K2.7 Code variant. It uses the same model capability with approximately 5-6x output speed at about 3x quota consumption; availability depends on the membership tier.
Moonshot Kimi K2.7 coding model with text, image and video input plus thinking mode.
Multimodal Kimi model with text, image and video input, thinking/non-thinking modes, tool calls and JSON mode.
Multimodal Kimi model with text, image and video input, thinking/non-thinking modes, tool calls and JSON mode.
MiMo multimodal model with text, image, video and audio input.
MiMo flagship text-only model.
Doubao Seed 2.1 Turbo multimodal model for complex reasoning and long-running agent tasks.
ByteDance Seedream flagship image generation model on Volcengine Ark, supporting high-resolution text-to-image and image editing via OpenAI-compatible /v1/images endpoints.
ByteDance Seedream 5.0 lite-tier image generation model on Volcengine Ark, up to 4096x4096 resolution, first in the family with web-grounded generation via real-time retrieval.

ByteDance Seedream 4.0 image generation model on Volcengine Ark, supporting 2K/4K text-to-image and editing via OpenAI-compatible /v1/images endpoints. Also distributed under the bytedance-seed/seedream-4.0 slug on aggregators.

Tencent Hy Team's open-weight flagship MoE (770B total / 49B active, Apache 2.0) tuned for coding agents and complex tool-use workflows, with 1M context (960K input + 64K output). Text-only with native function calling; reasoning defaults to high effort and can be set to low or disabled (no_think). Dated snapshots such as hy4-preview-20260827 share the same profile.

Fast and efficient language model by Sapiens AI, optimized for agent workflows, tool calling, coding, multi-turn dialogue, reasoning, and image understanding. Scores Pass^3 60.9% (rank 9) on Claw-Eval. Supports thinking mode via chat_template_kwargs or Anthropic-compatible thinking parameter.

High-performance image generation and editing model by Sapiens AI. Supports text-to-image, image-to-image, and multi-image composition. Ranked Top 20 (ELO 1184) on Artificial Analysis image editing leaderboard. API uses OpenAI-compatible /v1/images/generations endpoint. Standard price $0.003/image.

Upgraded image generation model by Sapiens AI, optimized for high information density images, complex compositions, and rich visual details. Supports text-to-image and image-to-image with composition preservation. API uses OpenAI-compatible /v1/images/generations endpoint. Standard price $0.003/image.

Production-grade video generation model by Sapiens AI. Supports text-to-video, image-to-video, multi-image video, and keyframe animation. Uses async task API (POST /v1/videos to create, GET to poll). Supports up to 441 frames (approx 18s at 24fps). Standard price $0.005/second.

Alibaba Wan 3.0 standard-tier all-in-one video generation model on Model Studio (DashScope), unifying text-to-video, first-frame / first+last-frame image-to-video and multimodal reference-to-video without switching model names. Generates up to 30s at 30fps in 480P/720P/1080P with optional output audio via the async video-synthesis task API (create task then poll task_id). Official China pricing CNY 0.3/0.6/1.2 per second by resolution (limited-time 30% off).

Alibaba Wan 3.0 high-speed-tier all-in-one video generation model on Model Studio (DashScope); capability-aligned with the standard wan3.0-video but with significantly improved end-to-end speed. Same task coverage (text-to-video, image-to-video, reference-to-video), up to 30s at 30fps in 480P/720P/1080P with optional output audio via the async video-synthesis task API. Official China pricing CNY 0.45/0.9/1.8 per second by resolution.
Google lightweight multimodal model; thinking on by default at minimal level, configurable via thinking_level.
Google GA multimodal agent model with thinking, structured output, function calling, code execution, and search/maps grounding.
Google GA multimodal agent model with thinking, structured output, function calling, code execution, and search/maps grounding.

Google Gemini-series image generation and editing model (Nano Banana successor), supporting text-to-image, multi-image composition and character consistency via the Gemini API and OpenAI-compatible gateways.
xAI frontier multimodal reasoning model for coding, agentic tasks, and knowledge work. Supports Responses and Chat Completions APIs; the official documentation states no text output limit.
xAI high-performance model combining the lowest hallucination rate with strict prompt adherence and agentic tool calling. Context pricing doubles for requests exceeding 200K tokens.
